title: Ukrainian-Style Open-Faced Sandwich
description: A hearty, open-faced sandwich filled with juicy meat and topped with a fried egg, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine.

ingredients.name: quality pork sausage
ingredients.notes: use a Ukrainian-style sausage if available

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the sausage in the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and cooked through.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened and caramelized.
Butter four slices of rye bread.
To assemble the sandwiches, place a slice of bread on a plate, top with a cooked sausage patty, a spoonful of onion, and a fried egg.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
